Coastal Waters Forecast
National Weather Service Honolulu HI
338 AM HST Wed Jul 29 2026

Hawaiian coastal waters within 40 nautical miles including the
Hawaiian Islands Humpback Whale National Marine Sanctuary.

PHZ100-300215-
338 AM HST Wed Jul 29 2026

.Synopsis for Hawaiian coastal waters...
Tropical Depression Fausto passes north of the islands today,
leading to light and variable over the coastal waters. Southeasterly
winds follow immediately in its wake and sweep from east to west
across the island chain through Thursday night. As Fausto moves 
off to the northwest and high pressure builds to the north, east- 
northeast trades will build back in and strengthen to fresh to 
locally strong levels Friday through the weekend. 

$$
